display_long_description:
🎮 A Complete & Authentic Cricket Experience

Step into Cricket Strike, a true-to-life VR cricket game built for fans who love realism, strategy, and match intensity. From pressure chases to legendary tournaments, every match feels competitive and authentic.

🕹️ Game Modes

Chase Mode – Target-based run chases
Super Over – High-intensity tie-breaks
Daily Challenges – Skill-based batting & bowling goals
Training Mode – Practice shots, timing, and match situations

🌍 International Tournaments

ODI World Cup – 2011, 2015, 2019, 2023
T20 World Cup – 2012, 2014, 2016, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2026
U19 World Cup – 2024
World Championship of Legends (WCL) – 2024, 2025
Asia Cup (2024,2025)
Champions Trophy (2017,2025)
🏏Domestic Leagues:
IPL (2019–2025), BBL (2023), PPL (2024–2025), BPL (2024–2025), SPL (2024), T20 Blast (2023), WIPL (2024)

🌍 Quick Match Mode

Choose from 24 international teams, including India, Australia, England, Pakistan, South Africa, New Zealand, Sri Lanka, West Indies, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, and more.

🏟️ Stadiums & Match Conditions

Iconic stadiums inspired by Abu Dhabi, London, and Delhi, with dynamic morning, afternoon, evening, and night match conditions affecting lighting, pitch, and atmosphere.

🧠 Advanced Gameplay Systems

AI-based intelligent fielding
Authentic batting & bowling mechanics
Hindi & English commentary
